workload_identities.node_iam_rule: node GSA receives only documented GKE node roles; no Secret Manager access
workload_secret_permissions: secretmanager.versions.access via roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on one role-specific secret resource; application requests one pinned version

allowed_binding_matrix.operator-project: private approved operator -> roles/container.clusterViewer plus separately reviewed Kubernetes RBAC
allowed_binding_matrix.grant-secret: grant-signer KSA/GSA -> roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on kapsel-gate2-authorization-grant only
allowed_binding_matrix.receipt-secret: receipt-stager KSA/GSA -> roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on kapsel-gate2-receipt-signing only
allowed_binding_matrix.tombstone-secret: sandbox-api KSA/GSA -> roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on kapsel-gate2-tombstone-digest only

key_inventory.access_identity: grant-signer Kubernetes service account via Workload Identity Federation
key_inventory.allowed_action: secretmanager.versions.access via roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on one role-specific secret resource; application requests one pinned version
key_inventory.audit: Secret Manager Data Access through bounded audit route
key_inventory.rotation: new grants use new version; admitted grants retain old trust
key_inventory.deletion_guard: delayed version destruction plus operator stop
key_inventory.backup_continuity: no secret payload backup; pinned live version remains until dependent grants, receipts, or tombstones expire and deletion is separately approved

key_inventory.access_identity: receipt-stager Kubernetes service account via Workload Identity Federation
key_inventory.allowed_action: secretmanager.versions.access via roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on one role-specific secret resource; application requests one pinned version
key_inventory.delivery: exact bytes staged into the accepted owner-private projected receipt-signing channel
key_inventory.audit: Secret Manager Data Access through bounded audit route
key_inventory.rotation: frozen receipts never re-sign; old trust survives public retention
key_inventory.deletion_guard: delayed version destruction plus operator stop
key_inventory.backup_continuity: no secret payload backup; pinned live version remains until dependent grants, receipts, or tombstones expire and deletion is separately approved

key_inventory.access_identity: sandbox-api Kubernetes service account via Workload Identity Federation
key_inventory.allowed_action: secretmanager.versions.access via roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on one role-specific secret resource; application requests one pinned version
key_inventory.audit: Secret Manager Data Access through bounded audit route
key_inventory.rotation: prohibited while protected tombstones remain unless compatibility is proved
key_inventory.deletion_guard: delayed version destruction plus operator stop
key_inventory.backup_continuity: no secret payload backup; pinned live version remains until dependent grants, receipts, or tombstones expire and deletion is separately approved

provider_fixed_management.export: none except bounded private evidence review

inventory.absence_postcondition: no fixture sink writer binding and policy digest equals the private baseline
JSON must contain no exclusion named kapsel-gate2-no-default-duplicate and must match the private baseline digest
JSON must contain no fixture-added Data Access audit category
no binding member may contain kapsel-gate2-

commands.partial_failure_rule: run global stop when possible, then execute every teardown entry whose inventory ID was observed created; tolerate not-found and retain the first non-not-found failure
commands.final_absence_rule: run every inventory absence_argv after teardown and again after the 24-hour expiry; any owned result rejects cleanup
commands.audit_route_expiry_rule: the private reviewer drains only allowlisted fields, the subscription retains unacknowledged messages for 600 seconds without retaining acknowledged messages, and teardown deletes subscription then topic; after 24 hours neither resource nor any Kapsel-controlled configurable copy may exist
commands.optimistic_policy_rule: every project or Pub/Sub topic set-iam-policy file is rendered immediately before use from the current policy etag, adds or removes only fixture-owned IAM, audit, or sink-writer deltas, and aborts on etag conflict
commands.default_sink_restore_rule: before digest must equal private authorization binding; after removing only the named fixture exclusion, after digest must equal before digest; any conflict or extra fixture exclusion rejects cleanup
commands.audit_topic_policy_restore_rule: before digest must equal the private authorization binding; the unique sink writer receives only roles/pubsub.publisher on the one topic; after removing that binding, the policy digest must equal the baseline
commands.project_scope_rule: every project-scoped gcloud argv pins --project=${PROJECT_ID}; PROJECT_ID is accepted only from the approved private account-binding digest render
